protocol.sampling: Every atom of the saved uniform finite prior, clean live only

protocol.sustain: All original checkpoints, at least five passing terminal checks

protocol.threshold_basis: A declared 10% partition-mass discrepancy cap. With 32 exact atoms, at most three atoms' worth of mass discrepancy is permitted. This rejects the historical gate's accepted 25/75 two-mode law. It is not a calibrated predictor of downstream image quality.
